response.original_title: The Russian Revolution: All Power to the Soviets!
response.overview: In 1991, the Soviet Union, one of the most powerful nations on Earth, collapsed. Born in socialist revolution almost three-quarters of a century earlier, its birth in 1917 sent shockwaves around the world. Right from the start, the Russian Revolution promised a better world of equality, dignity, and social justice. What happened to those promises?
response.title: The Russian Revolution: All Power to the Soviets!
